permissions-timestamp-info: The timestamp indicates the last update made to the repository permissions of this user. If the value <0>never</0> is displayed, it means we currently do not have any permission records for the user. However, please note that the user may have had permissions stored in Sourcegraph in the past.
permission-sync-jobs-list: List of permission sync jobs that fetch which <0>private</0> repositories the user can access on the code host.
accessible-repositories-list: List of <0>all</0> repositories the user can access on Sourcegraph.
